story.title: Russia hits Ukraine gas facilities after Trump claims 'energy ceasefire'
story.summary: Trump said he had brokered a cease-fire to protect energy infrastructure in Russia and Ukraine. But Ukrainian officials say bombs kept falling overnight on gas facilities, wounding 33 people.
